title: Returning From Houston - Hurricane Harvey
description:
Nellis Air Force Base greets returning airmen from their quick response mission to Houston, TX.  
23rd Wing assets are in support of Air Forces Northern as part of Northern Command's support of FEMA's disaster response efforts. The 23rd Wing prepositioned HC-130Js, HH-60Gs, aircrews and support Airmen to support potential tasking in support of Hurricane Harvey relief efforts.
Nellis airmen are ready at a moment's notice to respond and assist with any search and rescue taskings received.
